The '''Unification Summit''' of [[43 ABY]] was a series of negotiations held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an attempt to reincorporate the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[Confederation]] back into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

{{Event-stub}}

==History==
In the aftermath of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], peace was restored to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], though tensions remained between the three galactic powers; with neither [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or the [[Confederation]] rejoining the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

During the first public meeting of the three major powers in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], it was noticed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and other attendees that all three [[Head of State/Legends|Heads of State]]&mdash;[[Jagged Fel]] of the Imperial Remnant, [[Natasi Daala]] of the Galactic Alliance, and [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] of the Confederation&mdash;all had strong ties to the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Daala and Phennir served as an Admiral and General, respectively, while Fel was the son of leading Imperial fighter ace, [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]].

A [[Senate Unification Preparations Committee|committee]] was set up by the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] to prepare for the Unification Summit. It was headed by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tiurrg Drey'lye]].

In [[44 ABY]], the growing [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] revolts that were erupting all around the galaxy, as well as the tension between the [[New Jedi Order]] and Daala's government led the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] to order swift repression against the slave movements. Jagged Fel, who had successfully convinced the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] to unify with the Galactic Alliance, was disgusted by Daala's willingness to have anyone who revolted against the Alliance killed and even innocent people like journalist [[Madhi Vaandt]] who was killed during the [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt on Blaudu Sextus]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] working for Daala. Although he promised her Imperial troops to help destroy the revolts, he decided to withdraw the Remnant from the Summit as he wasn't willing to unite under the authority of Daala who had finally shown her true colors. He was also disgusted by the fact that she blamed the Jedi for the revolts even though she had no proof and it was only motivated by her hatred of them.
